changelog:
Initial public release of gsc-connect.

- Enables read-only integration between OpenClaw (or another MCP-compatible agent) and Google Search Console via YUSIHK's public MCP service
- Allows retrieval of official property, performance, sitemap, and URL inspection data using Google Search Console APIs
- Supports granular access to clicks, impressions, CTR, average position, queries, pages, countries, devices, and data ranges
- Includes setup and troubleshooting instructions for OpenClaw and Codex clients
- Restricts actions to read-only; no support for modifications, submissions, deletions, or ownership changes
- Provides clear workflow guidance for common GSC queries and result interpretation
summary: Connect OpenClaw or another MCP-compatible agent to Google Search Console and retrieve official read-only properties, performance, sitemap, and URL inspection data. Use for clicks, impressions, CTR, average position, queries, pages, countries, devices, dates, and indexing investigations.
